sources.title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 61st Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
sources.contribution: Introduces a self-training pipeline that generates instruction, input, and output samples, filters invalid or similar samples, and uses the resulting data for instruction tuning.
sources.limitation: The indexed record does not establish coverage of Singapore English/Singlish, Malay, Tamil, Singapore-context Mandarin, or community-led cultural review.
sources.relevance: Primary baseline for synthetic instruction generation and filtering.
sources.license_or_terms: ACL Anthology and DOI landing page available; verify publication license before redistribution.

sources.title: Prompting Multilingual Large Language Models to Generate Code-Mixed Texts: The Case of South East Asian Languages
sources.contribution: Studies prompting multilingual models to generate code-mixed text in seven Southeast Asian languages, including Malay, Chinese, Tamil, and Singlish, and reports inconsistent quality across language pairings.
sources.limitation: The indexed record describes prompting behavior and recommends extensive human checks; it does not establish SynthSEA's multi-agent verification or instruction-data downstream results.
sources.relevance: Directly relevant prior art for code-switching, SEA language coverage, and the need for human validation.
sources.license_or_terms: Open-access preprint; verify reuse terms for text and figures.

sources.title: SeaLLMs - Large Language Models for Southeast Asia
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, System Demonstrations
sources.contribution: Presents a large-language-model effort focused on Southeast Asian languages and provides regional multilingual model prior art.
sources.limitation: This is model and system prior art, not evidence that multi-agent synthetic instruction generation improves culturally reviewed data quality.
sources.relevance: Important regional baseline and comparison point for SEA multilingual model coverage.
sources.license_or_terms: ACL Anthology record; verify model and data licenses separately.

sources.title: Universal Dependencies Parsing for Colloquial Singaporean English
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 55th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
sources.contribution: Provides a Universal Dependencies treebank and parser work for colloquial Singaporean English.
sources.limitation: The task is syntactic parsing rather than synthetic instruction generation or cultural quality evaluation.
sources.relevance: Supports Singlish terminology, regional-language resource design, and evaluation-resource planning.
sources.license_or_terms: ACL Anthology record; verify treebank license before use.

sources.title: Mind Your Inflections! Improving NLP for Non-Standard Englishes with Base-Inflection Encoding
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
sources.contribution: Studies NLP robustness for non-standard Englishes including Colloquial Singapore English and proposes base-inflection encoding.
sources.limitation: The method addresses representation and downstream robustness, not multilingual synthetic instruction generation or cultural review.
sources.relevance: Motivates separate evaluation of Singlish and other regional varieties rather than assuming Standard English transfer.
sources.license_or_terms: ACL Anthology record; verify data and code terms before redistribution.

sources.title: Multi-VALUE: A Framework for Cross-Dialectal English NLP
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 61st Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
sources.contribution: Introduces a cross-dialectal evaluation framework and controllable rule-based transformations spanning many English dialects.
sources.limitation: The indexed scope is English dialect robustness; it does not cover the four SynthSEA language settings or multi-agent culturally grounded generation.
sources.relevance: Provides a methodological precedent for dialect-specific evaluation, synthetic transformations, and native-speaker partnership.
sources.license_or_terms: ACL Anthology record; verify benchmark and transformation-resource terms.
